company.name: My30Minutes EMS
company.shortDescription: MY30MINUTES is a fitness company that provides personal training, nutrition counseling, wellness, and weight-loss solutions.
company.description:
My30Minutes EMS is the UAE’s first and leading EMS (Electro Muscle Stimulation) fitness studio, established in 2013. We offer science-backed, time-efficient personal training designed for busy individuals who want real results with just one 20-minute session per week.

Operating across Dubai (Boxpark, JVC) and Ajman (Ladies Only), My30Minutes has helped over 10,000 clients achieve their fitness goals. Our premium training programs use Miha Bodytec EMS technology, guided by certified personal trainers.

We cater to professionals, athletes, and clients of all ages — offering private, duo, and home session options. With consistent 5-star reviews and a trusted reputation, My30Minutes has been recognized as the Best EMS Gym in the UAE by Arabian Best of Best Awards.

Why We Stand Out:
Over 10 years of proven EMS experience

Certified trainers and medically-approved technology

Flexible, contract-free packages

Zero equipment, zero hassle — just 20 minutes a week

Looking Ahead:
We are currently exploring growth opportunities through strategic partnerships and early-stage fundraising to expand our studio footprint across the GCC.
